subject: general
question:
Who was the founder of the Gupta Empire?

A. Chandragupta II

B. Samudragupta

C. Sri Gupta

D. Ghatookacha
solution:
Option **3** is the correct answer.

__
 
• **Sri Gupta** was the founder of the Gupta Dynasty.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **Mistake Points__**

__
 
• **Chandragupta Ⅰ** is considered to be the real founder of the Gupta Era which started with his accession in 319 – 320 CE.
 
• The year of his accession in A.D. 319 marks the beginning of the Gupta era.
 
• It was henceforth used in all their records, and also those of their feudatories. He took the title of maharajadhiraja (king of kings).
 
• **But in the Options there is only mention of Chandragupta II, not Chandragupta I. Hence, we marked the second best option **

Chandragupta II (380 – 413 AD)

 
 
 
 
• Killed Ramgupta and ascended the throne.
 
• Defeated Rudrasimha III and took the title of Vikramaditya.
 
• Fa-Hein, a Chinese traveller visited his court.
 
 
 
 

 
 
Samudragupta (335 – 375 AD)

 
 
 
 
• Napolean of India.
 
• Prayag Prashasti pillar inscription written by Harisena glorifies his conquests.
 
• Took the titles of Kaviraj and Vikramanka.
 
 
 
 

 
 
Sri Gupta (240 -280 AD)

 
 
 
 
• Founder of the Gupta empire.
 
• Was a vaishya ruler.
 
 
 
 

 
 
Ghatotkach (280 – 319 AD)

 
 
 
 
• The successor of Srigupta and succeeded by Chandragupta I.
